enchantments.tooltip: Striding +30%: This item makes you more fleet of foot, giving you a 30% Enhancement bonus your movement speed.
Insightful Dexterity +2: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
Move Silently +15: Passive: +15 Competence bonus to the Move Silently skill.
Woodsman's Guile: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a +4 bonus to your To-Hit and +6 bonus to your Damage on any attack that would be considered a Sneak Attack.
